title: Principal maximal ideal of a normalized finite Galois component stalk
statement: Let B be a DVR domain with fraction field K and irreducible uniformizer pi; let n > 0. Let E_i be a finite family of finite Galois extensions of K [def-weil-field, def-weil-vector-space-dimension], and let p:X -> Spec K be isomorphic over Spec K to the coproduct of Spec E_i. Set A = B[t]/(t^n-pi), q:Spec A -> Spec B, j:Spec K -> Spec B and a = pullback.snd(p followed by j,q). Assume a is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For every point x of its relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] over the root prime (t), the maximal ideal of the actual stalk C at x is principal. No unit condition or degree divisibility condition on n, and no normalization finiteness assumption, is needed.

proof.text: Apply dvr_uniformizer_root_algebra to A=B[T]/(T^n-pi), obtaining domainhood, DVR structure and m_A=(t). This handles n=1 by the same Eisenstein proof.

Apply dvr_generic_galois_normalization to the displayed base change. Its structural normalization morphism is finite and its stalk C at x is a normal domain. Finiteness over the Noetherian Spec A makes the normalized scheme locally Noetherian, so C is Noetherian.

The root-prime condition identifies the image prime s with m_A=(t), which is nonzero because A is a DVR. Its prime localization is a DVR by Mathlib IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_dedekind_domain. Spec.stalkIso transports this to the actual base stalk R.

The finite normalization morphism has quasi-finite stalk map R -> C. The comap on prime spectra is strictly monotone: comparable primes with equal contractions are equal by Algebra.QuasiFinite.eq_of_le_of_under_eq. Hence dim(C) <= dim(R)=1. The normal Noetherian domain C is therefore a Dedekind domain. Since C is local, Mathlib maximalIdeal_isPrincipal_of_isDedekindDomain proves that its maximal ideal is principal.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof from two fully proved new lemmas; #print axioms gives only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound for all three public theorems.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_galois_components_normalization_maximalIdeal_isPrincipal
    (B : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (r : ℕ) (E : Fin r → Type u) [∀ i, Field (E i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra (FractionRing B) (E i)]
    (hE : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) (E i) ∧
      IsGalois (FractionRing B) (E i))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B)))
    (e : X ≅ ∐ fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (E i)))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin r ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (FractionRing B) (E i)))) = p) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A))
    let j := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
    let a := pullback.snd (p ≫ j) q
    ∀ (hqc : QuasiCompact a) (hqs : QuasiSeparated a),
    letI := hqc
    letI := hqs
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)} →
      let C := a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x
      Submodule.IsPrincipal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C)
